name: Shindou Tamako
source:
She is one of the three JK part-timers in charge of the kitchen. She is basically emotionally inactive, but when the erotic switch is turned on, she turns into a dominatrix who prefers verbal aggression and rough play.

She uses ingredients to make snacks without permission and eats customers' orders, which increases the restaurant's deficit.

Despite appearances, she is a gluttonous person, and it is said that most of her part-time job salary goes to food expenses. She has a complex about her small breasts, and she is competitive with Yuka, who has huge breasts.
